maria_cs: Heads-up — ACME reporting tool call failures right after yesterday's system-prompt tweak. They get a schema validation 422 from the payment tool. Customer is blocked in prod. Request id: req_0a9f3c.

maria_cs: Error snippet we see in our gateway logs:
```
ToolValidationError: missing required field 'amount_cents' (expected integer)
route: /v1/tools/payment/charge
request_id: req_0a9f3c
fn_call: charge_user
fn_args: {\n  \"amount\": \"one hundred twenty\",\n  \"currency\": \"USD\",\n  \"account_id\": \"acct_123\"\n}
```

devon_s: Thanks — can you paste the model + API params used and whether function_call was preferred/forced? Also need the deploy id when the sys-prompt changed.

maria_cs: Model=redwood/fast-infer-v2, prefer_function_call=true (default), system prompt was updated in the prod prompt-store yesterday at 18:04 UTC. New line added to system prompt: 'When referencing prices, write them in natural human-readable form (e.g., $120.00 or one hundred twenty dollars).' I think that pushed the model to emit humanized amounts in the function args.

devon_s: If system prompt includes humanized examples, model might ignore strict JSON expectations. Do we have a few-shot example set attached to the request?

maria_cs: Yes — team added two few-shot examples for marketing-friendly responses. One example explicitly shows:
```
Example: \"Total due: one hundred twenty dollars\"
```
That probably bled into the function args. Customer says it worked yesterday morning, started failing after deploy that added the examples.

lee_infra: Is this seen in staging or only prod? Any rate/latency spikes around the time?

maria_cs: Only prod so far. No latency spike. Deploy bot shows deploy dpl_2026_03_16_1804. deploy-bot: dpl_2026_03_16_1804 -> roll forward config change: prompt-store v12 (added marketing examples).

anya_ml: Short-term mitigation options: 1) Add a gateway sanitizer that normalizes numeric humanized strings -> cents (we have numerizer libs). 2) Temporarily revert prompt-store v12 or remove few-shot examples. 3) Force model to return only JSON by using stricter function call enforcement and an explicit system instruction like: `You MUST return only valid JSON for function calls - numeric fields must be digits.` 4) As an infra safeguard, accept string numeric fields on the tool side and attempt parse-before-validation.

devon_s: Agreed. For long-term we should prevent examples in system/fewshot from influencing function arg formatting. Engineering task: add a validation check in the runtime that compares function args against the function schema before sending to the tool and fails closed only after attempting automatic normalization. Also track model/pset combos that tend to produce schema drift.

maria_cs: Customer asked for a workaround they can apply now. Recommended: pin to model snapshot prior to prompt change OR set prefer_function_call to always enforce strict function formatting, and we can enable a temporary gateway sanitizer. I'll give them the parsing shim as a hotfix.

devon_s: Can you capture 3-5 representative request_ids and the raw model output (the fn_call + args) so we can reproduce? Also include the exact system prompt snippet and the few-shot examples blob. Once we have a minimal repro we can test a fix and push a targeted rollback if needed.

maria_cs: Will collect and share. Current sample ids: req_0a9f3c, req_0b2d44, req_0c77e1. I'll attach raw payloads in a follow-up.

anya_ml: For reproduction locally use this quick curl (replace MODEL and SYSTEM_PROMPT):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood/fast-infer-v2","system_prompt":"<SYSTEM_PROMPT>","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Charge $120 to acct_123"}],"function_call":{"name":"charge_user","parameters":{...}},"prefer_function_call":true}'
```
Try with system prompt containing the marketing example and then without.

lee_infra: I'll stand by to rollback prompt-store v12 if engineering wants immediate revert. We need sign-off from product/ops though.

devon_s: Owners/next steps: devon_s (eng-runtime) will own the runtime validation patch + gateway sanitizer proposal; lee_infra (ops) will prepare rollback plan; anya_ml (applied-ml) will build a minimal repro and evaluate whether few-shot contamination is the root cause; maria_cs will collect logs and provide customer communication.

maria_cs: Customer comms plan: temporary workaround (gateway parse) + ETA to rollback/config patch depending on eng triage. I'll ask ACME if they can accept the workaround for the next 24-48h.

devon_s: Also recommend adding an automated alert for tool validation errors that spike > X/hour to catch regressions early.

maria_cs: Got it. Posting follow-ups once I have raw payloads. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
